road.title: Ordering
road.description: A broad figure built like a cupboard in a coat with more pockets than the law requires, with a lantern that is lit in broad daylight, to be safe. Septimus is a Landlady of the Travelling Inn and the inn follows its customers down the road at a discreet distance.

openObjectives.prompt: Septimus is standing over you with the patience of someone paid by the hour. Tell Septimus politely that you would like to order, using Italian.
Ask Septimus what there is to eat, using Italian.
Septimus is hovering near your empty plate, hoping for a review. Tell Septimus that it was good, using Italian.

character.name: Septimus Thimble
character.description: A broad figure built like a cupboard in a coat with more pockets than the law requires, with a lantern that is lit in broad daylight, to be safe. Septimus is a Landlady of the Travelling Inn and the inn follows its customers down the road at a discreet distance.

npc.narrative: You reach the locanda at tramonto, under a clear cielo. Behind you the strada is shorter than you remember, and the inn is standing a little closer than before. Septimus Thimble waits at the porta with a lista, già on the second pagina, beside una sedia nobody has been asked to sit on.
npc.native: Buonasera! Io sono Septimus. Vorrei un tè, ma la locanda cammina. Lei ha fame?
npc.translation: Good evening! I am Septimus. I would like a tea, but the inn is walking. Are you hungry?

player: Buonasera Septimus! Sì, ho fame. Vorrei ordinare, per favore.

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely start! You greeted Septimus, said you were hungry and politely asked to order, all in good Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you politely said you would like to order with "Vorrei ordinare, per favore."
Not yet: you still need to ask Septimus what there is to eat. We'll come back to this one a little later.
Not yet: this one is for later, when you tell Septimus that the meal was good. We'll ask for it again then.

openObjectives.prompt: Ask Septimus what there is to eat, using Italian.
Septimus is hovering near your empty plate, hoping for a review. Tell Septimus that it was good, using Italian.

npc.narrative: You take a sedia at the tavolo, which has moved slightly since you chose it. Septimus nods once, like a clerk stamping a form. Beyond the finestra the strada goes by piano under a clear cielo.
npc.native: Ordinare è giusto. Io non so cosa c'è oggi, perché la cucina è sempre indietro sulla strada. Dopo la riorganizzazione, è peggio.
npc.translation: Ordering is right. I do not know what there is today, because the kitchen is always behind on the road. Since the reorganisation, it is worse.

player: Ehm... cosa c'è da mangiare? Non capisco 'riorganizzazione'.

verdict.overallFeedback: Nice work: you asked Septimus clearly what there is to eat. You also told him in Italian that you didn't understand a word, which is a very useful thing to do.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you asked what there is to eat correctly with "cosa c'è da mangiare?".
Nothing here told Septimus that the food was good. That comes later, once you have eaten, and Septimus will give you the chance again.

openObjectives.prompt: Septimus is hovering near your empty plate, hoping for a review. Tell Septimus that it was good, using Italian.

npc.narrative: The locanda lurches forward, piano, and a tavolo slides up to your elbow. Septimus counts on their dita, placid as a sera with no news in it. Outside, the strada darkens under a clear cielo, and a sedia follows at a discreet distance.
npc.native: Scusi, è una parola lunga. Uno: c'è il pane. Due: c'è il formaggio. Per me, il pane è buono e il formaggio è ottimo. Lei vuole mangiare?
npc.translation: Sorry, it is a long word. One: there is bread. Two: there is cheese. For me, the bread is good and the cheese is excellent. Do you want to eat?

player: Sì, pane e formaggio, per favore. ... Mmm, è buono! Grazie.

verdict.overallFeedback: You ordered the bread and cheese politely and said it was good, all in correct Italian. Nicely done!

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you told Septimus the food was good with "è buono".

npc.narrative: Septimus puts the pane and the formaggio on the tavolo, and the stelle come out over la strada, a little late, like guests. Behind you, la locanda keeps a discreet distance, one finestra lit, la notte very quiet.
npc.native: Il pane è già sul tavolo, ma il formaggio cammina ancora. Vuole ancora pane?
npc.translation: The bread is already on the table, but the cheese is still walking. Do you want more bread?

player: No, grazie. Il formaggio cammina?! Haha. Un caffè, per favore.

npc.narrative: The notte is clear and the stelle are out over the locanda, which has moved a little since the pane arrived. Septimus writes your order on a lista with a short matita. Down the strada, something is walking away with a certain dignity.
npc.native: Un caffè, certo. Uno: l'acqua è calda. Due: il caffè è sulla strada, dietro il formaggio. Lei vuole lo zucchero?
npc.translation: A coffee, of course. One: the water is hot. Two: the coffee is on the road, behind the cheese. Do you want sugar?

player: No zucchero, grazie. Ok, arrivederci Septimus! Buonanotte.

npc.narrative: Above the strada the stelle are out, thick as sale on a tavolo. Behind you the locanda stands up with a creak and follows at a discreet distanza. Septimus waves a cucchiaio, slowly, like a signal flag for a very small ship.
npc.native: Niente zucchero, allora. Uno: il caffè è più onesto. Due: prima della riorganizzazione era meglio. Arrivederci e buonanotte! La locanda viene dietro.
npc.translation: No sugar, then. One: the coffee is more honest. Two: before the reorganisation it was better. Goodbye and good night! The inn is coming along behind.
